extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset comprising 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering (QA) pairs across five different task types.
extraction.creator: Xinhao Li, Yi Wang, Jiashuo Yu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhan Zhu, Haian Huang, Jianfei Gao, Kunchang Li, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
extraction.publisher: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanjing University, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai Innovation Institute
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is built by leveraging existing datasets (Ego4D, HowTo100M, HDVila, and MiraData). Dense event labels are generated for each long video by utilizing existing high-quality short video captions and filtering consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Existing datasets including Ego4D, HowTo100M, HDVila, and MiraData, encompassing movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, how-to videos, and other in-the-wild videos of long duration.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Consecutive segments are filtered and regrouped into long video sequences. A sequence of event labels with corresponding timestamps is constructed based on captions. For datasets without high-quality event-level annotations, major events are extracted from captions using an LLM. Long video QA pairs are then constructed based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations consist of long video QA pairs categorized into five tasks: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting. These are constructed based on video captions, event labels, and timestamps of short video segments. Major events are extracted from captions using an LLM.
